lines.text: After Missilis announces that it has enhanced the Alva Particle Purification Device,
the previous public outcry over Missilis's supposed incompetence swiftly dies down.
And just as everything was settling...

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: You sent for me?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Go to M.M.R.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Retrieve the remaining V.T.C. data.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Now? Of all times?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: This is a bit sudden.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Pray tell, what do you mean now, of all times?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: The Nikke blueprint sweetie made.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: That was undeniably real.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: She's achieved something no one else has since we entered the Ark. She's taking the Nikke body in a new direction.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: There's no way you're unaware of what it's worth.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: I wondered why you tossed it in the trash. Now I see...

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: What does any of this have to do with you going to M.M.R.?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: You have no intention of ever letting me out after that, do you?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Who's to say.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: You've already decided on the next CEO.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Is it sweetie?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Enough of this blithering nonsense.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Now that you've gotten everything you've needed out of me, you're casting me aside?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Off you go.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Once you return, the position of CEO will be yours.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Do you take me for a fool?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: You really think I'll go quietly?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I do.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Power. Ability. Connections.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Tell me, which of these do you have that surpasses me?
*Grits teeth*

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I trust you'd rather not be seen making such a pathetic spectacle of yourself, being dragged there by someone else.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: ... Father.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: One day, I will lay that brain of yours on a lab table and pick it apart, bit by bit.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: I'll make you regret you ever had me develop that memory-control device.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Do as you like.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: If you ever gain the means to do so, that is.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Go to M.M.R.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: And unless the CEO grants permission, or the board requests it,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: don't return to the Ark.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: The CEO's permission... or the board's request...?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Haha!

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: You really do consider your children as mere pawns, don't you?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Fine...

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: I will find my way back no matter what.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: And I will put you on my lab table if it's the last thing I do.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Do as you please.
Jien leaves.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Enikk.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Make sure the big one makes it to M.M.R. as instructed.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Unlike the small one, she's becoming somewhat formidable. She knows how to use that head of hers.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: ... Understood.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: If the conditions I named aren't met, cut off every route back to the Ark.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I'll be heading out in two days, as promised.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It seems the location has been triangulated.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: ... All right.
Enme switches on the screen and gazes at the red dot displayed on the vast map.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: At last... I've found it.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I'd rather not waste my strength on frivolous endeavors,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: so don't get in my way.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: This should complete our deal.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I've opened up communications so that your influence extends even to the surface.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes. I've confirmed communications to the surface.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Thank you, Enme.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Is Syuen confirmed as the next CEO then?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: The instant the big one sets foot in M.M.R., release the article.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Let everyone know that Missilis's CEO is changing.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Breaking news.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Following Elysion's recent change in leadership, we now hear that Missilis Industry will follow suit.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: The next CEO has been confirmed as Syuen, the youngest daughter of the current CEO, Enme.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Wha... What is this?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I became... what?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: The CEO...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Boss!
*Slam*

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I've only just stepped down, and already people are barging into my room without permission.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What are you thinking?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're stepping down as CEO...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: And you're not appointing Syuen as your successor, but putting her in charge immediately...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That little kid?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: The small one is a better fit for the Missilis of today than the big one.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You know it as well!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You know what that kid was hoping for!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You know all she wants is for her father to recognize her achievements just one more time!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But how... how could you do this instead?!

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Yes. Affection.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: That's what she wants, I suppose. She's always been that way since she was young.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Which is precisely why I won't give it.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Anyone who is satiated is bound to stagnate.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Did you really think I didn't like that blueprint?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What are you saying...?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: It's a genuine piece of work.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: To have the talent to produce a genuine Nikke blueprint at that age is impressive.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I haven't seen anything like that since the second generation Grimms models.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: She's truly of Missilis's bloodline.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: With talent like that, her age is irrelevant. She can manage being CEO just fine.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Even if her temperament worsens, or if she acts like a child,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: her innate ability will produce results regardless.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Then why did you say all those things to her...?!

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Like I said, anyone who is satiated is bound to stagnate.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Only those who are hungry and driven by desire can grow.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: So that's why you said what you said?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Calling her worthless and a nuisance?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Just for that reason alone?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Yes. In the end, she will reach greater heights because of it.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: If affection is what she craves most, all the better.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Had circumstances allowed her to be raised at my side,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I could have spoon-fed affection to her little by little, keeping it just beyond her reach while spurring her on. But it wasn't to be.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: So my only option is to withhold it from her for the rest of her life.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Enme!!
Maxwell slams her hand down on Enme's desk.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What do you even take your own child for?!

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: A monster.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Or someone with the makings of becoming one.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: As the head of a company built to hunt monsters,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: don't you think you have to become a monster yourself to qualify as CEO of Missilis?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You can still go up against the Raptures even without becoming a monster...!

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: The consequence of us showing mercy is there in plain sight, up in space.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: And yet, it looks like there's a fool who still believes she can win by coming at the enemy as mere humans.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: To think that fool was my own subordinate.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I took you for someone fairly clever, but in the end, you're simply another human who's grown complacent living in the Ark.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: If you're so desperate for a monster, you could have just appointed Jien CEO.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: She craves that position more than anything, so...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Yes. That's exactly why.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: It's precisely because that's what the big one desires the most.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: That's why I can never give it to her.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Because she'd be satisfied.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Even now, she believes she could win against the small one at any time.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: She's impossibly smug, condescendingly calling her sister "sweetie."

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: A monster must be kept hungry.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Someone who is satisfied stops growing.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: That cannot be allowed.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Otherwise, Missilis and the Ark would stagnate,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: when they have to keep expanding.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Lest they be devoured by the monsters.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... Fine. Let's say this monster theory of yours is correct.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But it's nothing more than that, a theory.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What if Syuen refuses to cast aside her humanity to become a monster? What then?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Then the big one will emerge and devour her.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Enikk would never sit by and watch Missilis fall.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: The small one will live in constant fear,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: never knowing when everything she holds might end up in the jaws of a monster.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: That's when she'll grow desperate to perform,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: whether she becomes a monster or not.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're... insane. How could you do this to your own child!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're the one who's the monster! Not Jien or Syuen!

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I know that.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Everyone born into Missilis is the same:

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: they're either a monster, or they fall short of becoming one.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: You think the small one is any different?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Syuen is different! She's truly...!

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Is that so? I wonder if you'll still be able to say that once time has passed.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: If you can't bring yourself to leave the small one's side,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: the day will come when you'll realize the truth in my words.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I will never let it come to that.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Oh? From where I stand, you're the most fitting one of all.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Fitting for what?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: With how affectionate you are,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: you'd be the perfect catalyst for driving the small one over the edge.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I told you, didn't I? If affection is what she's starved of,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: then I'll see to it she never has it, for the rest of her life.
*Fwip*
A thin needle flies through the air and lodges itself in Maxwell's shoulder.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What... what is this...
Maxwell lifts her head,
only to see a gun muzzle before her.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Stealth...?
A wave of dizziness washes over her, and she crumples to the floor.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Urgh!

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I was actually about to send for you myself. I appreciate you coming to me first.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: You absolutely cannot be present at the small one's inauguration, you see.
Maxwell loses consciousness.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Get her out of here.
Enme walks out, leaving Maxwell's crumpled form on the ground.
That evening, Enme, Missilis's second CEO, vanishes from the Ark without a trace.
